input: List all active guest profiles with their primary email and phone.
query: SELECT PId, FirstName, LastName, PrimaryEmail, PrimaryPhone FROM profiles WHERE IsActive = TRUE;

input: Show the latest 50 hotel stay records including guest name, arrival, departure, and room number.
query: SELECT s.PMSSId, p.FirstName, p.LastName, s.ArrivalWhen, s.DepartureWhen, s.RoomNumber FROM pmsstays s JOIN profiles p ON p.PId = s.ProfileId ORDER BY s.ArrivalWhen DESC LIMIT 50;

input: Find all restaurant reservations for a given profile ID.
query: SELECT * FROM restaurantreservations WHERE ProfileId = {{profile_id}} ORDER BY StartWhen DESC;

input: Get total spa spending per guest profile.
query: SELECT ProfileId, SUM(CAST(Price AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS TotalSpaSpent FROM spabookings GROUP BY ProfileId;

input: Which guests have booked a tennis or padel court in the last 30 days?
query: SELECT c.CBId, c.ProfileId, p.FirstName, p.LastName, c.CourtTypeDescription, c.StartWhen FROM courtbookings c JOIN profiles p ON p.PId = c.ProfileId WHERE c.StartWhen >= NOW() - INTERVAL 30 DAY;

input: Show the top 20 guests by total restaurant spending.
query: SELECT ProfileId, SUM(CAST(TotalSpent AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS RestaurantTotal FROM restaurantreservations GROUP BY ProfileId ORDER BY RestaurantTotal DESC LIMIT 20;

input: Find all spa bookings that were cancelled and show cancellation fees.
query: SELECT SBId, ProfileId, StartWhen, CancellationNumber, CAST(CancellationFee AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS CancelFee FROM spabookings WHERE IsCancelled = TRUE;

input: Show all tee-time bookings with number of players and course name for the last 7 days.
query: SELECT TTBId, ProfileId, CourseName, NumberOfPlayers, BookedDate FROM teetimebookings WHERE BookedDate >= NOW() - INTERVAL 7 DAY;

input: Get monthly revenue by revenue type for a given year.
query: SELECT Month, SUM(CAST(Revenue AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS TotalRevenue, RevenueType FROM profilemonthlyspend WHERE Year = {{year}} GROUP BY Month, RevenueType ORDER BY Month;

input: Which guests have checked in to any activity (spa, court, lesson) today?
query: SELECT ProfileId, 'spa' AS Source FROM spabookings WHERE DATE(StartWhen) = CURDATE() AND IsCheckedIn = TRUE UNION ALL SELECT ProfileId, 'court' AS Source FROM courtbookings WHERE DATE(StartWhen) = CURDATE() AND IsCheckedIn = TRUE UNION ALL SELECT ProfileId, 'lesson' AS Source FROM lessonbookings WHERE DATE(StartWhen) = CURDATE() AND IsCheckedIn = TRUE;

input: Show all pool and beach amenity reservations for cabanas.
query: SELECT PBARId, ProfileId, PoolBeachName, StartWhen, CompletesWhen, PriceQuoted FROM poolbeachamenityreservations WHERE PBAType = 'CABANA';

input: List profiles with VIP status and their last visit date.
query: SELECT p.PId, p.FirstName, p.LastName, p.VIPStatus, (SELECT MAX(s.ArrivalWhen) FROM pmsstays s WHERE s.ProfileId = p.PId) AS LastVisit FROM profiles p WHERE p.IsVIP = TRUE;

input: Get total combined spending (spa + restaurant) for each profile.
query: SELECT p.PId, p.FirstName, p.LastName, COALESCE(spa.SpaSpend,0) + COALESCE(rest.RestSpend,0) AS TotalSpend FROM profiles p LEFT JOIN (SELECT ProfileId, SUM(CAST(Price AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS SpaSpend FROM spabookings GROUP BY ProfileId) spa ON spa.ProfileId = p.PId LEFT JOIN (SELECT ProfileId, SUM(CAST(TotalSpent AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS RestSpend FROM restaurantreservations GROUP BY ProfileId) rest ON rest.ProfileId = p.PId;

input: Which guests have transportation reservations today?
query: SELECT ProfileId, Driver, Destination, NumberOfGuests, StartWhen FROM transportationreservations WHERE DATE(StartWhen) = CURDATE();

input: Get activity count per guest across all activity tables.
query: SELECT ProfileId, COUNT(*) AS ActivityCount FROM (SELECT ProfileId FROM courtbookings UNION ALL SELECT ProfileId FROM lessonbookings UNION ALL SELECT ProfileId FROM teetimebookings UNION ALL SELECT ProfileId FROM spabookings UNION ALL SELECT ProfileId FROM otherreservations) x GROUP BY ProfileId ORDER BY ActivityCount DESC;

input: Find guests who stayed in a room of type 'Suite' in the last 6 months.
query: SELECT s.PMSSId, s.ProfileId, p.FirstName, p.LastName, s.RoomType, s.ArrivalWhen FROM pmsstays s JOIN profiles p ON p.PId = s.ProfileId WHERE s.RoomType LIKE '%Suite%' AND s.ArrivalWhen >= NOW() - INTERVAL 6 MONTH;

input: Show the most frequently reserved restaurants.
query: SELECT RestaurantName, COUNT(*) AS TotalReservations FROM restaurantreservations GROUP BY RestaurantName ORDER BY TotalReservations DESC;

input: Get the number of visits per profile per year from visit history.
query: SELECT ProfileId, CAST(VisitCount AS UNSIGNED) AS TotalVisits FROM profilevisitsperyear;

input: List all lesson bookings with instructor name, lesson type, and guest name.
query: SELECT l.LBId, l.InstructorName, l.LessonType, p.FirstName, p.LastName, l.StartWhen FROM lessonbookings l JOIN profiles p ON p.PId = l.ProfileId;

input: Find guests who spent more than 5000 total in all categories combined.
query: SELECT p.PId, p.FirstName, p.LastName, CAST(p.TotalSpent AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS TotalSpent FROM profiles p WHERE CAST(p.TotalSpent AS DECIMAL(10,2)) > 5000;

input: Summarize this week’s occupancy and revenue.
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS TotalStays, SUM(CAST(TotalRevenue AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS TotalRevenue FROM pmsstays WHERE ArrivalWhen >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) DAY) AND ArrivalWhen < DATE_ADD(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) DAY), INTERVAL 7 DAY) AND StayStatus NOT LIKE '%Cancelled%' AND IsCancelled = FALSE;

input: Calculate occupied room nights and revenue for the current week.
query: SELECT SUM(DATEDIFF(LEAST(DepartureWhen, CURDATE()), GREATEST(ArrivalWhen, DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) DAY)))) AS OccupiedNights, SUM(CAST(TotalRevenue AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS TotalRevenue FROM pmsstays WHERE ArrivalWhen < DATE_ADD(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) DAY), INTERVAL 7 DAY) AND DepartureWhen > DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) DAY) AND StayStatus NOT LIKE '%cancel%' AND IsCancelled = FALSE;

input: What is today’s occupancy?
query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS OccupiedRooms FROM pmsstays WHERE CURDATE() BETWEEN DATE(ArrivalWhen) AND DATE(DepartureWhen) AND StayStatus NOT LIKE '%cancel%' AND IsCancelled = FALSE;

input: Show total hotel revenue for this week.
query: SELECT SUM(CAST(TotalRevenue AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS TotalRevenue FROM pmsstays WHERE ArrivalWhen >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) DAY) AND ArrivalWhen < DATE_ADD(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) DAY), INTERVAL 7 DAY);

input: Which departments are over or under performing this month?
query: SELECT 'Spa' AS Department, SUM(CAST(Price AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS Revenue FROM spabookings WHERE MONTH(StartWhen)=MONTH(CURDATE()) UNION ALL SELECT 'Restaurant', SUM(CAST(TotalSpent AS DECIMAL(10,2))) FROM restaurantreservations WHERE MONTH(StartWhen)=MONTH(CURDATE()) UNION ALL SELECT 'CourtBookings', SUM(CAST(BookingSalesValue AS DECIMAL(10,2))) FROM courtbookings WHERE MONTH(StartWhen)=MONTH(CURDATE()) UNION ALL SELECT 'Lessons', SUM(CAST(LessonSalesValue AS DECIMAL(10,2))) FROM lessonbookings WHERE MONTH(StartWhen)=MONTH(CURDATE()) UNION ALL SELECT 'TeeTime', SUM(CAST(BookingSalesValue AS DECIMAL(10,2))) FROM teetimebookings WHERE MONTH(BookedDate)=MONTH(CURDATE());

input: Show me the top customer segments by lifetime value.
query: SELECT PrimaryCountry AS Segment, COUNT(*) AS Guests, SUM(CAST(TotalSpent AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS LifetimeValue FROM profiles WHERE TotalSpent IS NOT NULL GROUP BY PrimaryCountry ORDER BY LifetimeValue DESC LIMIT 10;

input: What states are most frequent international guests coming from?
query: SELECT PrimaryState AS State, COUNT(*) AS GuestCount FROM profiles WHERE PrimaryCountry <> 'UAE' AND PrimaryState IS NOT NULL GROUP BY PrimaryState ORDER BY GuestCount DESC;

input: What regions or countries are our most frequent international guests coming from?
query: SELECT PrimaryCountry AS Country, COUNT(*) AS GuestCount FROM profiles WHERE PrimaryCountry <> 'UAE' AND PrimaryCountry IS NOT NULL GROUP BY PrimaryCountry ORDER BY GuestCount DESC;

input: Identify dates where we could have increased prices based on demand.
query: WITH occ AS ( SELECT DATE(ArrivalWhen) AS StayDate, COUNT(*) AS RoomsOccupied FROM pmsstays WHERE StayStatus NOT LIKE '%cancel%' AND IsCancelled = FALSE GROUP BY DATE(ArrivalWhen) ) SELECT StayDate, RoomsOccupied FROM occ WHERE RoomsOccupied = (SELECT MAX(RoomsOccupied) FROM occ) OR RoomsOccupied > (SELECT AVG(RoomsOccupied) FROM occ) * 1.20 ORDER BY RoomsOccupied DESC;

input: Show me trends in booking windows over the past year.
query: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(ArrivalWhen, '%Y-%m') AS Month, AVG(DATEDIFF(ArrivalWhen, CreatedWhen)) AS AvgBookingWindow FROM pmsstays WHERE ArrivalWhen >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 12 MONTH) AND StayStatus NOT LIKE '%cancel%' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(ArrivalWhen, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY Month;

input: Which days typically experience the most check-in?
query: SELECT DAYNAME(ArrivalWhen) AS DayOfWeek, COUNT(*) AS CheckIns FROM pmsstays WHERE StayStatus NOT LIKE '%cancel%' GROUP BY DayOfWeek ORDER BY CheckIns DESC;

input: Forecast the check-in for the next 90 days.
query: SELECT DATE(ArrivalWhen) AS ArrivalDate, COUNT(*) AS ExpectedCheckIns FROM pmsstays WHERE ArrivalWhen BETWEEN CURDATE() AND DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 90 DAY) AND StayStatus NOT LIKE '%Cancelled%' GROUP BY DATE(ArrivalWhen) ORDER BY ArrivalDate;
